text:
Morgan: Hey team — final check for Hobbyist Hall next week. Flights booked for staff, but need final decisions on swag counts, demo kit packing, and the post-event follow-up plan. Can we confirm by EOD?

Dina: I can take swag. Quick recap: 250 stickers, 150 postcards, 100 tees (mix S-XL). Is that still the plan? :tshirt: :sparkles:

Sam: 100 tees sounds fine but I recommend bumping stickers to 500 — stickers are the magnet for the booth. Also we should bring 50 mini cheat-sheets with our 3 benchmark callouts (latency, cost, rollout).

Leo: Shipping update — courier ETA for crates is Wed 9am. Need final packing manifest by Tuesday night. I left a spreadsheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example-hobbyist-hall (edit)

Olivia: Speaking submission got accepted for the 40-min stage slot (woo!). Need a 1-slide "what Redwood Inference solves" and a 2-min demo script. I can draft slides if someone sends the benchmark bullets.

Sam: Benchmark bullets (short):
- Median p95 text gen latency: 85ms (hosted, 8k context)
- Cost per 1k tokens after batching & caching: $0.21
- Canary rollback success rate: 99.6% (auto-fallback tested)

Dina: For messaging iteration at the booth: lead with "predictable inference economics" then show a quick live cost calc. Demo script should end with a CTA: "scan QR to schedule a trial".

Jen Ops: Packing manifest draft below — please confirm quantities. I'll print labels once you sign off.

```
Packing manifest (Hobbyist Hall)
- Crate A: 2x demo laptops, 1x local router, 1x spare GPU machine (for offline demos)
- Crate B: stickers x500, postcards x150, tees x100, mounts & banners
- Crate C: handouts x50, chargers, power strips x6, cable bag
- Misc: tape, gaffer, toolkit, first-aid
```

Morgan: OK on crates. Sam + Dina — confirm the postcards copy and the 3 benchmark bullets (Sam posted). Dina please confirm QR flow (HubSpot list + tag).

Dina: Postcard copy looks good. QR should land to /events/hobbyist and tag "hobbyist-hall" in HubSpot, then route to SDR queue #3. Proposed routing rules: ``if tag==hobbyist-hall then owner=SDR_Q3 else owner=marketing``.

marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar follow-up cadence template available at /marketing/templates/webinar-cadence. Recommended: Day1 email (thank you + slides), Day3 email (case study), Day12 invite to trial.

Leo: Logistics Q — do we need a local SIM for hotspot or will venue provide reliable net? Demo relies on streaming LLM responses so want to avoid flaky Wi‑Fi.

Sam: Bring both: primary venue Wi‑Fi + a local 5G hotspot SIM as fallback. Also pre-cache demo prefixes so we can demo offline in a pinch.

Olivia: For the talk, can someone QA the demo script with me Thurs 2pm? Also want to rehearse fallback messaging if demo goes offline (scripted line: "if latency spikes we'll show cached results + explain routing/prefetching").

Dina: I'll own the follow-up email copy. Draft will include: quick recap, benchmark bullets, link to GitHub demo, CTA to schedule a sandbox. I can hand it to growth for finalization.

Jen Ops: Swag order placed (order #RD-4492). ETA to office Tue afternoon. I'll move to crate packing list once it arrives. :truck: :white_check_mark:

Morgan: Two final asks: 1) Sam, create a 30-second social launch clip highlighting the talk + booth (we'll push on Day0). 2) Dina, set the inbound routing and share HubSpot view.

Sam: Will do. Rough storyboard: 5s intro logo, 15s quick demo clip (latency + cost overlay), 10s CTA to stop by booth + QR. Need any brand assets?

Dina: Use assets in /marketing/brand/hobbyist-kit. I'll create HubSpot sharing link and make sure the tag is applied automatically.

Olivia: Rehearsal confirmed Thurs 2pm. I'll invite Sam + Morgan + Dina.

Morgan: Perfect. If we all sign off here, Jen will print and label crates Tue AM and Leo will hand off to courier. Thanks everyone :rocket:

Sam: Signed off from design side.

Dina: Signed off on messaging + routing.

Jen Ops: Signed off on packing labels & swag.

Leo: Courier pickup scheduled Wed 9am. All set.
